purpose: The 24-run prospective pilot keeps its report, freeze, configuration, analysis and review packet in the tree. The raw per-run capture (results/raw/**) was retired from the tree after recording every file here; the bytes remain reachable in Git history at last_commit_with_retired_bytes. measured_sha256 is the value recorded by results/SHA256SUMS.json at measurement time; sha256 is the byte content in the tree at retirement. They differ only for the 52 files whose local home path was replaced by the sanitized public export (ADR-047), which docs/release/0.1.0/PUBLICATION-SNAPSHOT.json binds original to public hash.

retired_summary.aggregate_rule: sha256 over the sorted lines "<sha256>  <original_path>\n" of retired
